notes.title: PAX East 2025 Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Wow!

We've been accepted to exhibit at the PAX Rising booth at PAX East 2025! We're so psyched to show off our game along side 11 other amazingly talented teams and solo indie devs! Please check them out here! If you're going to PAX East, please stop by the PAX Rising booth and check us and the other games out! We'll be here for all four days, yapping and gaming :^D

Phew!

We've been hard at work these past couple months adding tons of new things to the game, from some music and art changes, to cool new story mechanics. The new demo builds are hot off the presses (just a couple hours old), and we're putting them up here for everyone to enjoy! This is the same build (minus a couple levels) that we're showcasing at PAX, so if you can't make it give the demo a download and let us know what you think!

Thank You!

If you've been following our game for a while, we'd like to extend a sincere thank you for your interest and support! We really hope you enjoy the new stuff we've added. If you saw us at PAX you're circling back around, welcome back! It's great to see you again, please give the demo a download and play to your hearts content!

This stuff really isn't possible without people like you, so we'd like to dig deep to the bottom of our hearts and share with you all our deepest appreciation. We've got more cool stuff coming down the pipe, so don't go anywhere!

-- The First Pancake Team <3
